units.source_text: 已故式部卿亲王的女儿宫君，在大公主所居的西殿那里有她自己的房间。

en.t: Miyagimi, the daughter of the late Prince Shikibukyo, had her own room in the west wing where the elder princess lived.

units.source_text: 许多青年侍女都在那里看月亮。

en.t: Many young gentlewomen were there gazing at the moon.

units.source_text: 薰大将想：“唉，可怜！

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "Ah, how pitiful!

units.source_text: 此人与大公主同是皇家血统呢。”

en.t: She too is of royal blood, just like the elder princess."

units.source_text: 他回思式部卿亲王当年曾经有心将此女许配与他，觉得非无缘故，便走向那边去。

en.t: Remembering that Prince Shikibukyo had once intended to give this daughter to him in marriage, he felt there must be some bond between them and walked in that direction.

units.source_text: 但见两三个相貌姣好的女童，穿着值宿制服，在外面闲步。

en.t: He saw two or three pretty young girls in night-duty robes strolling outside.

units.source_text: 看见薰大将走过来，连忙退入室内，其娇羞之态可爱。

en.t: When they saw General Kaoru approaching, they hurried back indoors, and their shy manner was charming.

units.source_text: 但薰大将觉得这是世间常见之相。

en.t: But General Kaoru thought this was a common enough sight in the world.

units.source_text: 他走近南面一角里，咳嗽几声，便有一个年事稍长的侍女走出来。

en.t: He approached a corner on the south side and coughed a few times, whereupon a somewhat older gentlewoman came out.

units.source_text: 薰大将对她说道：“我常想对宫君表示同情之意。

en.t: General Kaoru said to her, "I have long wished to express my sympathy to Miyagimi.

units.source_text: 但用世人惯说的老生常谈，反而好像模仿浮泛的应酬话，所以正在努力‘另外觅新词’呢。”

en.t: But if I use the worn-out phrases everyone says, it seems like mere empty courtesy, so I am trying to 'find some other new words.'"

units.source_text: 那侍女并不进去通报宫君，自作聪明地答道：“我家小姐意外地身逢此种境遇，

en.t: The gentlewoman did not go in to announce him to Miyagimi, but answered on her own clever impulse, "My lady has unexpectedly fallen into these circumstances,

units.source_text: 常常回想起亲王生前对她的宠爱。

en.t: and she often remembers how lovingly the prince treated her while he was alive.

units.source_text: 又蒙大人时时寄予深切的同情，她闻知了不胜欣慰。”

en.t: She has also heard of your lordship's constant deep sympathy, and it has comforted her beyond measure."

units.source_text: 薰大将觉得这是对普通人的应酬话，无甚意味，心中颇感不快，说道：

en.t: General Kaoru felt that this was the sort of polite answer given to ordinary people and meant very little, so he was rather displeased and said,

units.source_text: “我与你家小姐是嫡堂兄妹，原有不可分离的族谊。

en.t: "Your lady and I are first cousins by the main family line, and we naturally share a bond of kinship that cannot be severed.

units.source_text: 尤其是小姐身逢此种境遇，更应多多关怀。

en.t: Especially now that she is in such circumstances, I ought to show her all the more concern.

units.source_text: 今后倘有事务见嘱，定当乐为效劳。

en.t: If she has any matter to entrust to me from now on, I will gladly be of service.

units.source_text: 但倘疏远规避，叫人传言通话，则我不敢再来访问了。”

en.t: But if she keeps her distance and avoids me, speaking only through others, then I will not dare to visit again."

units.source_text: 侍女觉得的确怠慢了他，心甚不安，便力劝宫君亲自应对。

en.t: The gentlewoman felt that she had indeed treated him discourteously, and, deeply uneasy, urged Miyagimi to answer him herself.

units.source_text: 宫君便在帘内答道：“我今孤苦无依，‘苍松亦已非故人’了。

en.t: Miyagimi then replied from behind the curtain, "I am now lonely and without support, and 'even the green pines are no longer old friends.'

units.source_text: 乃蒙不忘旧谊，令人铭感五中。”

en.t: Yet you have not forgotten our old bond, and I feel gratitude engraved deep within my heart."

units.source_text: 这不是命人传言，而是亲口对答，其声十分娇嫩，并有优雅之趣。

en.t: This was not a message passed through someone else but her own direct reply, and her voice was very delicate, with an elegant charm.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“这倘是住在这里的一个普通宫女，倒是很有意思的。

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "If she were an ordinary court lady living here, she would be quite intriguing.

units.source_text: 但她是亲王家的女公子，只因今日处此境遇，不得不与人直接通话。”

en.t: But she is the daughter of a prince's house, and only because of her present situation must she speak directly with others."

units.source_text: 他很可怜她。

en.t: He felt great pity for her.

units.source_text: 推想她的容貌亦必非常美丽，颇思见她一面。

en.t: Imagining that her appearance too must be exceptionally beautiful, he very much wished to see her once.

units.source_text: 忽念此女定然使得那匂亲王苦思劳心，觉得可笑。

en.t: Then he suddenly thought that this woman must surely have caused Prince Niou much longing and distress, and he found it amusing.

units.source_text: 却又慨叹世间理想的女子不易多得。

en.t: Yet he also sighed that ideal women were not easily found in this world.

units.source_text: 他想：“这宫君是身份高贵的亲王悉心教养成长的千金小姐，

en.t: He thought, "This Miyagimi is a cherished daughter raised with great care by a prince of high rank,

units.source_text: 然而这种环境之下产生的美人，并不稀奇。

en.t: but a beauty produced in such an environment is not especially rare.

units.source_text: 最稀奇的，是出生于高僧一般枯寂的八亲王之家，

en.t: What is rarest is to be born in the house of the Eighth Prince, a place as austere and lonely as that of a high priest,

units.source_text: 成长在荒凉的宇治山乡中，而个个长得美玉无瑕。

en.t: to grow up in the desolate mountain village of Uji, and yet for each of them to become as flawless as a beautiful jewel.

units.source_text: 连那个被人视为身世飘零、意志薄弱的浮舟，

en.t: Even Ukifune, who was regarded as someone of drifting fortunes and weak will,

units.source_text: 对晤之时，也令人觉得非常优雅可爱。”

en.t: seemed extremely elegant and lovely when one met her face to face."

units.source_text: 可见他无论何时何地，都只是想念宇治一族的人。

en.t: Thus, wherever and whenever he was, he thought only of the people of the Uji family.

units.source_text: 暮色沉沉之时，他历历回思对她们的异常恶劣的因缘，感伤不已。

en.t: As the dusk deepened, he vividly recalled the strangely unhappy ties he had had with them and sank into sorrow.

units.source_text: 忽见许多蜉蝣忽隐忽现地飞来飞去，遂赋诗云：

en.t: Suddenly he saw many mayflies flickering in and out of sight as they flew about, and so he composed a poem:
